title: UNBS E-Portal Clears Imports Clearance Delays, Improves Turnaround Time
retrieval: Official indexed primary text read through web search; direct HTML retrieval403 saved as error response, not article content.
findings: E-portal users create accounts with TIN and email.
Portal integrates with Customs, assigns inspectors/payment references and automatically generates ICC after inspection.
Consignments lacking PVoC undergo destination inspection with inspection fees plus15% CIF surcharge.
No express personal-postal recipient rule or compulsory separate-account statement.
